Answer: D
Reason: The chest radiograph shows a small, hyperlucent right hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal shift and an anomalous curvilinear vascular shadow (scimitar sign) near the right heart border, which are classic features of hypogenetic lung syndrome (scimitar syndrome). This congenital anomaly is frequently associated with recurrent pulmonary infections and other congenital defects like laryngomalacia.
